name: aipe-monorepo
description: Spec workflow CLI for AI-assisted development. Root package wires the github install path; the publishable package lives in cli/.

scripts._comment_build: Run before committing or releasing — produces cli/dist/ (which IS checked in so npm install -g github:... works without a build step). On a fresh checkout: `npm install` here, then `npm run build` to refresh dist.

_comment_dependencies: Mirrored from cli/package.json. Mirroring runtime deps at root means a global install puts them in the global node_modules adjacent to cli/, and node's upward resolution from cli/dist/cli.js finds them.
_comment_devDependencies: Build-time only — used when running `npm run build` locally to regenerate cli/dist before committing. Not needed at install time because cli/dist is checked in.
_comment_files: node_modules deliberately excluded — npm refuses to pack node_modules into tarballs. Listing only what should be packed lets the standard tarball flow work; npm install -g re-installs `dependencies` into the global node_modules at the proper level for node resolution to find them.
